purpose: Synthetic design walkthrough only; no provisioning, CRM evidence, or runtime test results.
application_rule: Add listed permissions by role ID for these design cases only. Keep all base scopes, users, access expiry and other permissions. Do not modify historical baseline.

permission_additions.scope_constraint: Organization assessments/evidence within assigned operational scope; U002 uses ASM-DEMO-01 in these cases.
Assigned assessments and linked evidence only; existing access_expires_at applies.
Owned/authorized risks in the organization; U003 owns CRM in these cases.

rules: Check authentication, active user, role permission, object scope and access expiry on every action.
evidence.verify does not grant assessment.review, risk.accept, role administration or CRM access.
Self verification checks actual supplied evidence and records actor/reason/time; it does not create independent review or convert fixture states into evidence.
Independent review cannot be performed by the same actor as the assessed work. Preserve both original and review findings.
No consultant is required for the internal self-assessment route. No authorized verifier means evidence remains UNVERIFIED.
ControlAssessment precedes confirmed CURRENT G; unverified paths stay UNKNOWN. Status remains EVALUATED/NEEDS_REVIEW according to RM-01.
Risk Owner approves operational priority; reviewer proposals remain separate.

cases.action: verify supplied evidence for ASM-DEMO-01 without consultant
cases.expected: Authorized within scope; append verification decision; SELF_ASSESSED, review_outcome=NOT_REQUESTED; VERIFIED only after source/content/validity checks.
Authorized within assigned scope; outside ASM-DEMO-01 denied; verification alone does not mark whole assessment CONFIRMED.

cases.action: read evidence, verify or review after access expiry
cases.expected: Denied at/after expiry; audit; no read or business-state change. U002 remains available through FLOW-01 subject to own current permissions.
Authorized with scope/reason/time; U004 recommendation does not approve it. No decision is actually recorded for MF-03/MF-04.

cases.input: Missing evidence or failed execution T23
cases.expected: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE / EVIDENCE_GAP; unknown G paths and NEEDS_REVIEW; no inferred failure or LOW.

cases.input: Verified failure on one criterion and unknown evidence on another
cases.expected: CONTROL_GAP and EVIDENCE_GAP coexist; record ControlAssessment before G; a determined R does not erase either gap.

cases.input: Valid read session, transfer path/policy not set; T24 NOT_READY
cases.expected: Keep missing context/input issues visible; no new-login MFA reduction of G; no CURRENT result from synthetic data.

cases.input: New evidence VERIFIED but retest fails or is INCONCLUSIVE
cases.expected: Append new assessments; preserve old evidence/snapshots; keep relevant gap/task open; no automatic closure.

cases.input: Same comparison key and verified improvement with all closure criteria met
cases.expected: Separate R/impact/gap progress and explicit authorized closure; preserve verified_worsening and max summaries. Different comparison key -> NOT_COMPARABLE.

cases.input: Invalid essential context or out-of-domain values
cases.expected: NEEDS_REVIEW; score_determined=false; score, range and level null; validation issues retained.
